# Project Index for LLMs & AI Agents

> Solid 2.0 + Ark UI + Park UI + Panda CSS + SpacetimeDB + ConnectRPC Starter
> 2026 Modern Fullstack Foundation (Paved Path Edition)

## Architecture Overview
- Runtime: Bun
- Reactivity: Solid.js 2.0 (Zero VDOM, fine-grained signals)
- UI Primitives: Ark UI 5.x (Zag.js state machines) & Park UI
- Styling: Panda CSS with `strictTokens: true` & `strictPropertyValues: true`
- Realtime Database: SpacetimeDB 2.x
- RPC Transport: ConnectRPC
- Lint & Format: Oxlint & Biome 2.6

## Design System Rails (鋪鐵軌而非設陷阱)
1. **Zero Magic Numbers & Zero Hex Codes**:
   - `padding: "13px"` and `color: "#3b82f6"` are rejected at compile time.
   - All properties must use tokens from `~/components/ui/tokens`.
2. **宣告 Margin 死亡 (Declare Margin Dead)**:
   - Zero `margin`, `mt`, `mb`. Spacing is exclusively orchestrated via parent `<Container>`, `<VStack>`, `<HStack>`, `<Grid>` using `gap`.
3. **Compound Invariants**:
   - `<Card.Root>` and `<Dialog.Content>` encapsulate their own padding, gaps, and borders.
4. **Typography First**:
   - Never use raw `<p>`, `<span>`, `<h1>`. Use `<Heading>`, `<Text>`, and `<Code>`.
5. **Schema SSOT**:
   - All database, reducer, and API types derive from `src/schema/`.
